entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the sensor, or is it more of a preference issue?
What does it matter?! It doesn't do what I thought it would. Your ads are a joke. I've had it for almost three weeks and I'm done with it. Process the return.
I understand your frustration. Let me just pull up your order details to check the return eligibility. Can you please confirm the email address used for the purchase?
It's furious_cyclist@email.com. And don't you dare tell me it's too late or give me some excuse about hygiene. That's nonsense and I'll file a chargeback and blast you all over the internet.

Thank you for that. I hear your concern, and I just need to review the official policy for this specific item. Our guidelines can vary, especially with concerns around sanitation for wearable devices. One moment.
This is unbelievable. I want to speak to your manager. This shouldn't be this hard. Get me a manager right now!

I understand your request for a manager, but please allow me just a moment to check the system. I might be able to resolve this for you right now... Okay, I've just reviewed the official return policy for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It looks like you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you.
Oh. Well... why didn't you just say that? Fine. So what do I do?

I've just initiated the return and I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email you provided. Simply pack the sensor back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be credited back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Alright. Make sure that email comes through.
It has just been sent from my end. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
